task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a large, smooth, purple-red spherical mass with a glossy, vascularized surface occupying the lower central field, surrounded by yellowish adipose tissue and pinkish-red peritoneal membranes. A slender, metallic surgical instrument enters from the bottom right, its tip contacting and gently manipulating the surface of the mass. The camera slowly pans and tilts, shifting the perspective to reveal more of the mass's upper curvature and the adjacent tissue planes, including a distinct, pale, circular structure embedded in the reddish tissue at the top center. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the wet, reflective textures of the internal organs and the instrument.
